scope: Bounded resource/content-state presentation refinement in shared evidence review. Readable captured identities; separate native record versions and observed external state; reference role, scope, explanation and exact source pins. Technical inspection and regressions only; no broad requirement conformance, human validation or new core primitive.
changes: Resource-only names use captured descriptors rather than short UUIDs; existing engineering keys/titles remain authoritative.
External content comparisons show captured/latest metadata, availability, location, time and hash/commit instead of empty native field panes. Native-only field/statement comparisons remain intact.
Declared relationship summaries retain independent roles/scopes. Ordinary domain relationships remain meaningful without reference qualification.
A reference pin is associated with content metadata only for an exact declared observation of its target; missing matches stay explicit rather than substituting a later source state.
Source text is not retained and passage relevance remains unknown. No observation, review, outcome or dependency is inferred from viewing.

regressionCases: Captured label retained despite current rename; unchanged native revision with changed observed content
Exact pin metadata and mismatching pin without inferred inputs
Two scoped references share one target without collapsing their identities
Native revision pin remains distinct from endpoint context; live selection and ordinary domain links
Unsupported typed selector escaped/preserved and passage unknown
Unavailable/latest-missing observations; known change and unknown state coexist
View and reload retain byte-equivalent complete project exports and original outcome

visualInspection.method: Repository Playwright workflow; actual pixel review of desktop/phone screenshots
fixtures: Synthetic power specification with two references and observed hash drift

visualInspection.findings: Source identities, metadata and scopes are readable; long paths/hashes wrap; matching references remain compact and independent. Phone uses stacked content states and scrolling; desktop compares metadata in columns. No horizontal page overflow in new production journeys.

verificationHistory: Focused fixture preparation initially omitted complete RelationshipInput fields and native pin provenance, and used the wrong schema discriminator. These test-data errors were corrected; strict types and focused journeys passed before the final full run.
Collaborative preview snapshot failed twice with Preview automation snapshot timed out after 15000ms. Used repository Playwright screenshots for pixel inspection; no preview snapshot success claimed.
limits: Independent fresh-agent findings motivated this correction; this slice was implemented and technically inspected by the primary agent, not a new unfamiliar-user study.
No representative-human validation or standards conformity is asserted.
External bytes, passage resolution/reanchoring and semantic applicability assessment remain outside this slice.
Prior reports/receipts are retained. New observations of edited source files may show drift for older evaluations without rewriting their outcomes.
